method: Static first reasoned review: atomscan --no-update --mode slow, cleave facts (including decoded text), dnfile/dncil CIL disassembly, rizin control-flow disassembly, and Ghidra ARM64 decompilation. No sample was executed. Verdicts come from code paths, not ML scores, filenames or family labels.

samples.identification: NanoCoreFinal-branded custom managed RAT with ransomware and disruption attempts; genuine NanoCore lineage is not established
evidence: Main exits on native/managed debugger checks, VM detection and timing checks, then obtains its own assembly path, copies itself, writes Run values and a startup BAT, and invokes schtasks onlogon. It attempts an ms-settings/DelegateExecute/fodhelper UAC hijack and launches Defender-disable and administrator-account commands.

KeyloggerModule.Start installs WH_KEYBOARD_LL. HookCallback records key labels with active-window context; SendLoop writes keylog.log and passes records to SendToC2. Clipboard polling and CopyFromScreen screenshot loops similarly construct records. This is actual surveillance code, not just the presence of hook imports.

PasswordRecoveryModule's worker constructs Chrome/Edge Default profile paths and passes existing Login Data, Cookies and History files to SendFile. The file worker also issues netsh wlan show profiles key=clear and records its output. This command reference does not prove successful recovery of a Wi-Fi password.

The reverse-shell worker creates TcpClient and cmd.exe with redirected standard streams; paired relay delegates bridge network input and child output. The HTTP worker reads /cmd responses, handles file/browse commands, and launches other text through cmd /c with captured output.

Main calls the VFW webcam worker at method 0x0600001b, RVA 0x23fc. It creates a capture window, sends WM_CAP_DRIVER_CONNECT (1034) and WM_CAP_FILE_SAVEDIB (1061), checks for a temporary BMP, reads it, creates a Base64 record, and deletes the temporary file. Capture success is not established; the new trait describes a frame-save attempt.

The microphone worker has a device-count test and launches an implausible PowerShell AxHost recorder command; no successful audio capture is inferred. The method named ProcessHollowing actually starts notepad, writes a small buffer into remote allocation and starts a remote thread; it does not unmap/replace the process image. AMSI_Patch and ETW_Patch are merely messages sent to the logger, not implemented patches.

RealEncryption's worker (method 0x06000069, RVA 0x4718) enumerates Desktop/TestFolder, reads files, constructs an AES CryptoStream, writes suffixed output, then deletes the original. Its static IV is 14 bytes, so set_IV fails before encryption/output/deletion. Existing file-replacement-attempt wording is accurate. Wallpaper and ransom-note routines still implement deceptive extortion displays.

SendToC2 XORs UTF-8 bytes with a 32-byte modulo-indexed key generated as index XOR 0xaa, Base64 encodes the result, escapes it into a GET query and sets NanoCore/1.2 as User-Agent. Config.C2_DOMAIN already includes http://, but callers prepend http:// again. This malformed configuration prevents a normal connection to the intended host; no successful exfiltration or remote tasking is claimed. Local surveillance and hostile system-modification attempts remain concrete.

Recovery-inhibition, process-tool killing, firewall disabling, SafeBoot deletion, IFEO Debugger changes, USB self-copy/autorun writes and termination-critical setup are independently present in called routines. Existing findings describe code or references and are retained.
samples.marker: NanoCoreFinal-branded RAT: add VFW frame-save attempt coverage

samples.identification: Damaged StormAttack/Shtormec-style native x86 persistence and DLL-injection loader with appended junk-code section
evidence: Entry VA 0x402674 calls dispatcher 0x401cb0. The mode DWORD at file 0x4120 is 3; the branch at 0x401f75 selects Active Setup installer 0x401900, followed by cleanup 0x401390.

Installer 0x401900 constructs an HKLM Active Setup Installed Components entry and writes StubPath at 0x401a4b. It reads its own executable, patches a copied buffer, writes it with fwrite at 0x401b26 and launches the new path through CreateProcessA at 0x401b7e.

Cleanup obtains the current module path, converts it to an 8.3 path, builds a COMSPEC /c del command targeting itself, and calls CreateProcessA at 0x4014b8 followed by ResumeThread. This is self-removal code paired with retained injection and persistence.

Alternative mode 1 calls resource extraction, LanmanServer replacement and injection helpers. Routine 0x401260 deletes/replaces ServiceDLL under HKLM/SYSTEM/CurrentControlSet/Services/LanmanServer/Parameters; RegSetValueExA is called at 0x40133e. This capability is retained but is not selected by the initial mode-3 branch.

Routine 0x401150 creates a calc/notepad/Internet Explorer child, allocates remote memory, writes the DLL pathname, resolves Kernel32!LoadLibraryA and passes the resolved export plus remote path to CreateRemoteThread at 0x40123d. Mode 2 contains service-install/dispatch code.

All 40032 resource bytes at file 0x5000..0xec60 are zero. FindResource cannot retrieve the intended DLL, and successful payload installation is not demonstrated. Legacy resolved IAT contents and old-layout self-copy patch offsets further limit deployability.

The appended 8192-byte .htext section at file/RVA 0xf000 contains calls into old helper routines followed by long cancelling INC/DEC, self-exchange and repeated BSWAP padding. The initial entry remains unchanged. Junk instructions are confirmed, but no new ransomware, downloader or DDoS behavior is inferred from this section.

The decoded URL-like finding is mechanical percent-decoding of a printf GUID format. It is neither an endpoint nor a network operation. No cryptographic encryption or ransom demand occurs in this loader.

samples.identification: Coruna-associated ARM64 iOS native stage loader and error-reporting dylib; not evidence of a GHOSTBLADE/P7 credential-stealing module
evidence: Mach-O MH_DYLIB, install name x01, iOS minimum 13.0. Export _process at 0x68d8 initializes context callbacks, surveys OS/kernel/CPU and dyld state, applies version gates, checks the emulator state, then starts a detached worker at 0x6c44.

Helper 0x71fc calls stat(/usr/libexec/corelliumd) and returns a rejecting boolean when the emulator daemon is present. It conditionally resolves IOKit registry APIs and probes IOPlatformSerialNumber. _process separately checks L2 cache size, boot arguments and host information; nonempty/nonblank kern.bootargs can reject execution. These are real conditional analysis gates, not inference from ordinary sysctl strings alone.

Routine 0x7720 uses task_info TASK_DYLD_INFO to inspect loaded-image state and searches for WebContent. This checks the current environment; it is not proof of injection into a separately opened WebContent process. IOSurfaceRoot appears in sandbox_check policy queries, not an IOServiceOpen exploit in this dylib.

The worker reaches 0x5fec. It calls the context fetch callback at +0x40 (initialized to 0x9300), obtains bytes, conditionally applies the ChaCha-family transform at 0xad8c, then calls 0x8430. The latter recognizes a 0x0bedf00d compressed-record header and calls compression_decode_buffer with sixth argument 0x306 (LZMA). The cipher constant is split by cleave text extraction into the word expand, although its full bytes remain at 0xbb80.

The loader stages the decoded module through supplied mapping callbacks, prepares a reusable executable arena, and includes mmap(NULL,16MiB,7,0x1802,-1,0) at 0x6534. At 0x641c it invokes the context export-lookup callback with _start; at 0x65b4 it invokes the returned entry through the pointer-authentication call trampoline. The callback implementation is supplied by the surrounding exploit framework, so a particular downloaded payload and its downstream effects cannot be recovered from this file alone.

Pointer-authentication compatibility trampolines at 0xb0fc et seq. initially caused Ghidra to mark caller paths as nonreturning. Clearing inferred noreturn flags and call-flow overrides in the analysis project exposed the continuation paths; rizin ARM64 instructions independently confirm the fetch/decode/map/export-dispatch sequence. The sample bytes were not patched for this analysis.

Reporting callbacks initialized at context +0x5f0 lead to 0x9580/0x9398, format escaped error/file/line fields through 0x94b4, and wrap them in a logmsg command. Routine 0x8b5c creates CFHTTP requests, selects POST when a body is supplied, sets headers, opens a CFReadStream and collects response bytes. URLs and optional transport callback are supplied by the caller; no hardcoded live C2 was contacted.

No path sending the probed serial number was found. The previous fingerprint-exfil-dylib finding was unsupported and is retired. The defensible hostile behavior is an evasive, network-fed in-memory executable loader; family corroboration uses a distinctive escaped-error/logmsg template pair.
samples.marker: Coruna iOS stage loader: correct exfil claim and add loader traits

changes_and_placement: Add an objective for the iOS emulator-probe/HTTP/decompression/executable-memory/entry-dispatch code profile, and strengthen Coruna identity with this behavior plus a local, section-bound protocol fingerprint. Replace the unsupported fingerprint-exfil identity rather than retaining a misleading alias.

Move the IOPlatformSerialNumber reference to os/sysinfo/machine-id; move the boot-arguments reference to os/sysinfo/config. Update exact consumers. Bare boot arguments are notable configuration evidence, not suspicious VM detection. Require a Corellium probe in the retained hardware/VM composite.

Remove obsolete boot-argument tool-context exceptions once the neutral atom no longer needs exclusions. Remove the duplicated sandbox-check metadata alias: calling a security API does not establish artifact hardening. Move Mach task query symbols from dynamic-library lookup to current-task information.

Move the generic logmsg JSON template to data/format/json, WebContent name to process/info/name, and IOSurfaceRoot reference to hardware/iokit/registry. Retire the freestanding product user-agent token into the more discriminating family fingerprint; it did not establish Coruna identity or network activity by itself.

Add notable CFHTTP construction and request-stream APIs, the Apple compression-decoder API, ARM64 LZMA argument layout, executable-mapping argument layout, and structural entry-dispatch call layouts. Add a bounded __const byte fallback for the existing ChaCha/Salsa constant, suppressed when the canonical text observation already matches.

Move cron's foreground/nofork command-line observation from executable paths to process/argument/option and update its two daemon-masquerade consumers. This is an argument observation rather than a bare path. The path leaf was at its 100-rule budget; correction of this misplaced existing entry admits the new Corellium executable-path reference without raising budgets or inventing taxonomy subdivisions.

Move dlsym plus cleanup/error APIs from dylib/load/runtime to dylib/lookup, preserving the matcher/scope. Neither dlsym with dlclose nor dlsym with dlerror requires library loading. No exact external consumers referenced the removed ID.

Remove unsupported T1574.006 search-order-hijacking mappings from firing ordinary dlopen/dlsym/dlclose observations, T1071.001 from the generic HTTP POST file, and B0032 packing from the neutral Mach-O ratio file. These mechanics and measurements do not establish those attacks.

Add the CIL SaveDIB call layout and a camera-collection objective requiring independently established hook-keylogger context plus VFW capture and file-read evidence. It describes attempted frame saving, not successful webcam recording or exfiltration. The native loader's already accurate findings need no sample-specific exception or change.
reference_audit: Exact references to relocated IDs were updated. Added facts require their own roles in new composites; no source and sink roles are counted through a broad needs threshold. Cron ancestor audit found only generic fs/ operation-cooccurrence consumers; their selected PE/PowerShell scopes do not overlap the ELF-only moved observation. No package exception was introduced. The cipher fallback cannot duplicate its canonical text finding. The three load/runtime ancestor consumers concern source acquisition, DLL side-loading and PnP/service installers. Losing a lookup-only alternative is intentional: the removed alternative never proved loading. Native sample identity/hostile findings are unchanged; all final originals and mutation controls pass.

external_context.use: Microsoft independently describes the StormServer.dll/LanmanServer ServiceDLL replacement and Internet Explorer injection lineage. Driver overwrite, anti-AV and DDoS capabilities in that report are not transferred to this damaged loader.

Primary-source search result corroborates Coruna as an iOS 13.0-17.2.1 exploit framework. Full-page access and the supplied tria.ge/Bazaar pages were unavailable. No external source is asserted to prove this exact sample's behavior or to establish GHOSTBLADE/P7 identity.

verification: verify.py performs 13 original/mutation/near-miss scans, including all three required final atomscan scans. Controls independently remove Corellium, the cipher constant, the entry-invocation layout, family protocol content, serial-name reference, the CIL SaveDIB message and the capture API. Cron -f/-n references match after relocation while a bare cron path does not. Full scan/facts/disassembly/decompiler outputs are retained in the named scratch directory. results.json records the checks.
